fact_notes.fact: Ordinary PBS discovery enumerates top-level matching text files and assigns by registered base name; the nested Gen5–8 backup directories are not thereby activated.
fact_notes.premises: Unmodified fixed R discovery entry and ordinary filesystem enumeration; explicit caller-supplied backup paths are a separate case.
fact_notes.gap: Not a successful backup promotion/compile or generation compatibility test; all backup base records still incomplete.

fact_notes.fact: Species form fields have their own schema. Omitted scalar/collection fields inherit via the form compiler; ordinary lists are cloned, nested moves/evolutions clone their member arrays. Any explicit wild-item pool suppresses inheritance of all three pools.
fact_notes.premises: Existing valid base record, current active parser and successful field validation; per-record resolved values require that exact generation base.
fact_notes.gap: Gen5 base suffix and all Gen6–8 base records unread; abilities/moves/items references and runtime getters not closed.

fact_notes.fact: Species lookup tries species_form and falls back to the registered base. A missing explicit backup form cannot alone establish a missing runtime form capability.
fact_notes.premises: Valid registered species, form argument and fixed lookup; dynamic handler/caller behavior still requires separate evidence.
fact_notes.gap: Pokemon getters, dynamic handlers, generation gates and battle callers unread.

fact_notes.fact: All four metrics files contain 674 explicit sections with four properties; missing valid species/form metrics are lazily registered from base/defaults. Form sprite arrays are cloned. Later-generation absent rows are not proof of graphical failure.
fact_notes.premises: Species registered; fixed metrics class; explicit source metrics only in attested full ranges.
fact_notes.gap: Main reception pending; complete battle/hatching/trading/resource/persistence consumer chains unread.

fact_notes.fact: Metrics sprite offsets multiply by two with player/foe index parity; front altitude applies on foe sprite; shadow offset handling is separate. Pokedex back display applies back vertical times two.
fact_notes.premises: Valid sprite and metrics object in the fixed consumers; graphics/host dependencies satisfied only conditionally.
fact_notes.gap: No observed pixels; full battle scene consumers and actual media unread.

fact_notes.fact: Encounter compiler validates registered type/species and positive weights/levels, fills omitted maximum from minimum, merges equal species/level intervals and sorts by descending weight then species. Section versions default to zero; duplicate sections fail after the preceding section is registered.
fact_notes.premises: Explicit compile paths and required registries present; no guarantee all backup references resolve.
fact_notes.gap: All source slots read, but species/item/move registry combination and actual compiling NOT_EXECUTED.

fact_notes.fact: Direct encounter get prefers the specified version and then version0. Version iterator on normal Symbol-key registry still yields version0 when a nonzero version exists; map5v0/v1 records provide a finite contrast.
fact_notes.premises: Normal fixed compiler-produced Symbol keys, current version1 and existing map5v0/v1.
fact_notes.gap: Already documented; no new omission proposed. Main independent disproof/reception and runtime observations pending.

fact_notes.fact: Current-map encounter setup copies step chances and deep-copies slot tables. Candidate selection reads that snapshot; direct specified-map selection reads registered data. Registration/file changes alone do not refresh the current-map snapshot.
fact_notes.premises: Existing PokemonEncounters instance set up successfully; subsequent version setter/map entry not included in this completed source readset.
fact_notes.gap: Version setter, entering-map caller and editor command definitions unread.

fact_notes.fact: Wild held-item selection treats identical three pools as the first selection branch; otherwise cumulative common/uncommon/rare thresholds depend on lead abilities. Generation then applies shiny/Pokerus/gender/nature/form/event modifications.
fact_notes.premises: Successful Pokemon.new and valid live lead/player/bag/settings; this states the read generator body, not all data combinations.
fact_notes.gap: Pokemon initialization/getters, item definitions and received creature_b evidence absent; generation NOT_EXECUTED.

fact_notes.fact: Metrics writer chooses output suffixes from nonzero-form entries, emits base records only in chosen paths, and suppresses form entries equal to their base. Editor save writes binary metrics before PBS text; close without saving reloads binary metrics.
fact_notes.premises: Live registry and filesystem write/load success; failure may leave a prefix of operations complete.
fact_notes.gap: Already documented conditions; serializer host behavior, debug command caller, recovery and file failures NOT_EXECUTED.

fact_notes.fact: Ordinary Pokedex registration resolves the display-form receiver and checks its form name. Recent-seen registration uses current-record form name while storing its display alias. The forms list excludes aliases and unnamed alternate records.
fact_notes.premises: Valid registered source/receiver species records and Pokedex instance; Pokemon species_data getter still not source-verified.
fact_notes.gap: Per-record base inheritance unclosed; Alcremie source data does not alone prove successful host display or save/reload.

fact_notes.fact: Gen5 base prefix includes forty complete species records through WIGGLYTUFF and only ZUBAT header/name. It includes all explicit prefix fields, move lists, text, item/evolution declarations; it gives no evidence for the unread remainder or other generations.
fact_notes.premises: Exact P02 bytes and read ranges only.
fact_notes.gap: Full per-record/per-field semantic forward mapping not completed; three entire base files unread.

scope: Twelve finite static fact notes, not twelve accepted units and not an exhaustive mapping of read records. Every section retains an explicit open mapping disposition.
